M11 ROCprofiler-SDK Notes
========================

Module build status
-------------------
tensilelite_profiler built and installed successfully against:
  rocprofiler-sdk 1.3.2 at /opt/rocm/core-7.14/lib/cmake/rocprofiler-sdk/

All six Python functions are exported:
  initialize, start, stop, enable, disable, fetch.

CONFIGURATION_LOCKED behavior
------------------------------
The plan states that ROCPROFILER_STATUS_ERROR_CONFIGURATION_LOCKED is returned
by rocprofiler_force_configure when "HSA was initialized by a HIP call before
import".  This was tested and found to be INCORRECT for rocprofiler-sdk 1.3.2.

Tested scenarios that do NOT trigger CONFIGURATION_LOCKED:
  - amdgpu_exec.get_chip() (calls hipGetDeviceProperties)
  - amdgpu_exec.GpuBuffer(1024) (allocates GPU memory)
  - amdgpu_exec.GpuModule(hsaco) (loads code object)
  - ctypes call to hsa_init()
  - ROCPROFILER_TOOL_LIBRARIES env var with a pre-loaded tool

What DOES trigger CONFIGURATION_LOCKED (value 16):
  - Calling rocprofiler_force_configure a second time after a successful
    first call in the same process (verified via ctypes).

This means the "import before any HIP call" constraint is a best practice
recommendation (necessary for correct profiling), but it cannot be enforced
via CONFIGURATION_LOCKED detection in the current SDK version.

The TestImportOrdering test has been updated accordingly:
  - test_error_message_substring_present_in_source: verifies the error-handling
    code exists in bindings.cpp.
  - test_second_force_configure_is_locked: verifies the actual locking mechanism
    via direct ctypes call.

SQ_WAVES multi-dimension note
------------------------------
On gfx950 (MI350), SQ_WAVES is reported per XCC x SE x INST dimension.
The counter string format is:
  SQ_WAVES(XCC=0,SE=0,INST=0): 0, SQ_WAVES(XCC=0,SE=1,INST=0): 4, ...
Some (XCC, SE) pairs report 0 (no work dispatched to that shader engine).
The test asserts that the sum across all dimensions is positive, not that
any single dimension value is positive.

GPU test results
----------------
TestProfilerUnavailable:                               3/3 passed (no GPU required).
TestImportOrdering::test_error_message_substring:      PASS.
TestImportOrdering::test_second_force_configure:       PASS (gfx950).
TestCounterCollection::test_sq_waves_positive:         PASS (gfx950, sum=64).
